svg.title: Activation continuum
svg.desc: Arousal describes activation; it is not the same as anxiety. The useful level depends on the person and task. There is no fixed midpoint.

g.text: Arousal describes activation; it is not the same as anxiety.
Sleepy or sluggish; engaging with the task may take effort.
Alertness and energy increase along the continuum.
Very energised; tension or rushed movement may occur.
The useful level depends on the person and task. There is no fixed midpoint.
